title: The agent asks before it spends, and says roughly how much
description: Fabio, 2026-09-21: the in-app agent must not run a BILLED cloud model without a yes/no card first, and that card has to say in one short sentence roughly what it will cost. Today a cloud op just runs. The gate is the agent:confirm seam in services/agentLoop.mjs (kind install exists for a download, kind batch was added by MPI-870) plus _appendConfirm in MpiAgentChat.js; the PRICE comes from dev_configs/deepinfra-prices.json via deepinfraPricing.js. Composes with MPI-870's batch confirm: N cloud cards is ONE card naming N x the per-image price, never N cards. Depends on MPI-875 for the rank and the cost note; this card is the gate only, not the ranking. Under the MPI-817 agent-reliability umbrella.
